newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 7-mth direct financing up 0.4 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 7-mth direct financing up 0.4 pct on yr.

text.p: Direct financing by South Korean companies in stock and bond markets rose 0.4 percent to 19.29 trillion won for the first seven months of this year from 19.21 trillion a year earlier, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Wednesday.

A securities watchdog statement said South Korean companies had mobilised 1.78 trillion won in the Seoul bourse during the seven-month period through rights issues and initial public offerings. This is a 27.8 percent fall from 2.47 trillion won a year earlier as the stock market was sluggish.
